title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
description: Make AI reason step by step — the technique that produces dramatically better results on complex problems.

data.text: Chain-of-thought prompting is one of the most well-researched improvements in prompt engineering. It works by asking the AI to show its reasoning before giving an answer — and this dramatically reduces errors on complex tasks. The simple phrase "think step by step" can double accuracy on reasoning problems.

When an LLM generates a reasoning chain before its final answer, each step conditions the next step. The model is essentially writing its working notes, and those notes guide it toward a more logical conclusion. Without this, it jumps straight to an answer — often missing intermediate reasoning that would have corrected an error.

data.caption: Without chain-of-thought, the AI jumps to an answer. With it, reasoning becomes a visible chain where each step grounds the next

rows: Most analytical tasks — easiest to use
"First identify the key factors. Then rank them. Then recommend."
"Walk me through your reasoning, then give your conclusion."
High-stakes answers where you want to check the logic
"What is the strongest argument AGAINST this conclusion?"
"Argue for the best option from multiple perspectives, then give your verdict."

data.title: Job offer — without chain-of-thought
data.content:
"Should I accept this job offer?"

→ Gets a generic pros/cons list that could apply to anyone. Not personalized, not contextual, probably not useful.

data.title: Job offer — with chain-of-thought
data.content:
"I have a job offer 20% higher salary, fully remote, at an early-stage startup (Series A). My current role is stable, mid-size company, 5-min commute. I value career growth and financial security equally.

Think through this step by step:
1. Analyze the financial impact (salary, equity, benefits)
2. Assess career growth trajectory at each company
3. Evaluate lifestyle factors (remote vs commute, company culture signals)
4. Weigh the risks specific to an early-stage startup
5. Give a recommendation with your reasoning."

→ Returns a genuinely personalized analysis that actually helps you decide.

data.title: Business problem — with chain-of-thought
data.content: "My SaaS product's monthly churn rate increased from 3% to 7% in the last 60 days. I haven't changed pricing. Think step by step through the most likely causes and rank them by probability. Then describe the first diagnostic action I should take for each."

rows: Forces consideration of all relevant factors before concluding
Chains through steps prevents jumping to wrong first hypothesis
Some help — but for real math use the code interpreter
Unnecessary overhead when the answer is direct
Less relevant — free generation is usually better here

data.text: For the most critical decisions, ask the AI to first argue FOR the option, then argue AGAINST it, then give a final weighing. This two-sided analysis surfaces blind spots you might not have considered.

data.title: Key points
points: Adding "think step by step" is the simplest and most powerful prompt upgrade
Chain-of-thought improves accuracy by making reasoning process visible and sequential
Most valuable for decisions, analysis, root cause, and planning tasks
Combine with role-play for even better results: "As a CFO, think step by step through..."
